brief.question: Build an original-branded anime streaming-style web app (home with hero carousel and rows, genre browse, search, series page with seasons/episodes, browser-saved watchlist, YouTube trailer player) modelled on the browsing experience of crunchyroll.com.
brief.purpose: A non-coder wants a working look-alike browsing experience with a sample catalog of real titles (metadata only) and official trailers via YouTube embeds.
constraints: Clean room: do not open or fetch the original site or its code
Original name, logo and accent colour; no Crunchyroll trademarks
Never link to or stream unlicensed episodes; trailers only via YouTube embeds
Static build output in app/dist; change files only in app/
brief.done_when: npm run build succeeds and the static site provides all six requested pages working at phone, tablet and desktop widths without sideways scroll.

plan.title: Study the captured pictures of the original
plan.why: Capture only shows a bot-check page; design taken from the request and the genre instead

plan.title: Set up the app and the sample show catalog
